inclusion.I1: Study uses Voxel-Based Morphometry (VBM), fMRI (resting‐state or task based), or FDG‐PET as the imaging modality to analyze whole brain
inclusion.I2: Sample- participants included at least 6 human, clinically diagnosed behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) patients

exclusion.E2: Study should not focus on Parkinson's disease

inclusion.I3: Study uses Voxel-Based Morphometry (VBM), fMRI (resting‐state or task based), or FDG‐PET as the imaging modality
inclusion.I4: Sample- participants included clinically diagnosed behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) or picks disease patients
inclusion.I5: Sample- At least 6 participants in the patient group, and if there is a healthy/control group, at least 6 particpants in the control group
inclusion.I6: Studies that reported at least one result of a between‐group contrast in a defined stochastic space (i.e., Montreal Neurological Institute [MNI] or Talairach) comparing bvFTD group to controls, where bvFTD group is not pooled with other patient groups in this result.
inclusion.I7: Whole-brain evidence- The paper must report at least one group-level, whole-brain (voxelwise) result that is clearly identified as coming from the target sample group.
inclusion.I8: It is acceptable for qualifying whole-brain results to be reported in tables of coordinates, figures, or supplementary materials, as long as they are clearly described in the text.

exclusion.E6: Studies that report only region-of-interest (ROI) analyses with no whole-brain results.
exclusion.E7: Sample- with no concurrent psychiatric diagnosis (e.g., major depressive disorder and bipolar mood disorder), other forms of dementia or neurological symptoms, and no history of alcohol or substance abuse
exclusion.E8: Non-empirical papers (e.g., reviews, meta-analyses, methods-only, simulations) without original data.
exclusion.E9: only reports seed‐based functional connectivity (FC), diffusion tensor imaging (DTI), or cortical thickness methods

inclusion.GLOBAL_I1: uses Voxel-Based Morphometry, fMRI (resting‐state or task based), and  (Fluorodeoxyglucose Positron Emission Tomography) as the imaging modality
inclusion.GLOBAL_I3: Sample- particpants included clinically diagnosed behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia patients with no concurrent psychiatric diagnosis (e.g., major depressive disorder and bipolar mood disorder),other forms of dementia or neurological symptoms, and no history of alcohol and substance abuse
inclusion.GLOBAL_I4: Whole-brain evidence- The analysis must be from a group-level, univariate whole-brain (voxelwise) task-evoked statistical map (e.g., main effect or within-group contrast) that is from the healthy/control group and is generalizable to the healthy adult population.

exclusion.GLOBAL_E2: Seed-based connectivity, effective connectivity (e.g., PPI, DCM), or resting-state analyses (e.g., ICA, PLE, Hurst exponents)
exclusion.GLOBAL_E3: Between-group contrasts or interactions (e.g., subgroup vs subgroup, patient vs control)
